description:
ACCOUNT MANAGER

Remote — United States | Full-Time

ABOUT FREED

Doctors are overworked, burnt out, and leaving the profession at alarming rates.

At Freed, we combine clinician love with the latest AI technology and intense execution to create products that make clinicians happier.

Our first product is an AI scribe that automates medical documentation.

Since May 2023, we have:

  • Acquired over 28,000 paying clinicians who love our product.

  • Generated over 70,000 patient notes daily and more than 2 million monthly.

  • Made thousands of clinicians happier.

With the backing of Sequoia Capital and other world-class investors, we’re rapidly expanding our product offerings. Patient-facing assistants, patient insights, EHR integrations, and other products are being built and used by thousands of clinicians every day.

We’re looking for entrepreneurs: fast, ambitious, and smart individuals who want to take care of the people who care for our health.

Freed is headquartered in San Francisco, with team members working remotely and in person across the United States.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Account Manager at Freed, you’ll help medical practices successfully adopt and grow with our products.

You’ll work with a portfolio of small healthcare practices, building customer relationships, supporting product adoption, and identifying opportunities to strengthen and expand accounts.

This is a fast-paced, customer-facing role that combines relationship management, problem-solving, and commercial ownership.

We’re particularly interested in candidates with backgrounds in sales development, customer success, or other customer-facing roles who are excited to grow their careers in account management.

You’ll thrive here if you’re proactive, organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and motivated by helping customers succeed.

Above all, your responsibility is to help Freed deliver on our promise: to be the most clinician-friendly company in the world.

HOW YOU’LL HAVE IMPACT

To be completed and reviewed by Maddie.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

To be completed and reviewed by Maddie.

Target candidate profile: Approximately 6 months–5 years of relevant professional experience, particularly candidates with SDR, sales, customer success, or related customer-facing backgrounds.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working in a SaaS or technology environment.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

  • Experience supporting small businesses or healthcare customers.

  • Interest in AI-powered technology and healthcare.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.

WHAT WE WILL BRING

  • Competitive compensation and equity in a high-growth company.

  • The opportunity to make an immediate impact on a rapidly growing product that improves clinicians’ lives.

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for eligible U.S.-based employees.

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • A 401(k) plan to support your long-term financial goals.

  • A collaborative, ambitious team committed to making healthcare better.
